desc:
• SOURCE OF CALCIUM: Golden Grahams S'mores flavor cereal treat bars have a good source of calcium

  • S'MORES GO GOLDEN: These bars feature crispy graham cracker cereal pieces, marshmallows, and chocolatey chips for irresistible S'mores flavor

  • LUNCH BOX FAVORITE: Add to the pantry, pack in a lunch box, and keep on hand for snack time; These single serve bars make tasty, on the go after school snacks

  • PERFECTLY PORTABLE: Take the delicious cereal crunch and flavor of these snacks with you anywhere; Individually wrapped bars are easy for car rides, after class activities, and anytime sweet cravings pop up

  • CONTAINS: One big cardboard box of Golden Grahams Treat Bars, S'mores, Snack Bars, Value Pack, 16 Ct, 16.96 oz; Perfect for instant snacking
features:
Features

Chewy King-Size Bar (Approx. 2.1 oz)
A larger portion to keep you full and satisfied between meals.

Individually Wrapped
Perfect for lunchboxes, office snacks, or travel.

Authentic S’mores Flavor
Combines chocolate, marshmallow, and graham cereal for a true s’mores taste experience.

No Cholesterol or Trans Fats
A better-for-you option compared to many candy bars.

Good Source of Calcium
Each bar offers around 15–25% of the recommended daily calcium. 

Benefits

On-the-Go Indulgence
Ideal for busy lifestyles—no prep required, just grab and enjoy.

Kid- and Family-Friendly
A fun, sweet treat that appeals to both children and adults.

Satisfies Cravings
The mix of textures and flavors hits sweet, crunchy, and chewy notes all at once.

Calcium-Enriched
Supports bone health with a good boost of calcium per serving.

Nostalgic and Comforting
Perfect for fans of Golden Grahams and the classic s’mores experience.
ingredients: Cereal (whole grain wheat, corn meal, sugar, brown sugar syrup, canola and/or sunflower oil, dextrose, baking soda, salt, natural and artificial flavor. Vitamins and minerals: calcium carbonate, tricalcium phosphate, vitamin C [sodium ascorbate], iron and zinc [mineral nutrients], a B vitamin [niacinamide], vitamin B6 [pyridoxine hydrochloride], vitamin B1 [thiamin mononitrate], vitamin A [palmitate], vitamin B2 [riboflavin], a B vitamin [folic acid], vitamin B12, vitamin D3), Corn Syrup, Chocolate Flavored Coating (sugar, palm kernel oil, cocoa powder, soy lecithin, salt, milk), High Fructose Corn Syrup, Fructose, Marshmallows (sugar, corn syrup, modified corn starch, gelatin, natural and artificial flavor, blue 1), Canola Oil, Milk Chocolate Flavored Chips (sugar, palm kernel and/or palm oil, cocoa [processed with alkali], nonfat milk, soy lecithin, vanilla extract), Crisp Rice (rice flour, sugar, barley malt extract, salt, caramel color), Sugar. Contains 2% or less of: Vegetable Glycerin, Calcium Carbonate, Maltodextrin, Sorbitol, Gelatin, Soy Lecithin, Salt, Color Added, Natural And Artificial Flavor.
